notes: Complete original instruction-byte equality is only a candidate mapping. Each function still requires original JP source-unit ownership, native IDO output, complete ROM proof and ELF/relocations.
7,076 original JP assembly disassembly entries were indexed; original ELF contains 7,376 positive functions. The difference should not be assumed to be missing decompilable C.
Different functions can share short machine-code signatures. Repeated low-byte signatures have ambiguous semantics and are not proofs.
Two exact main-executable byte-clear and byte-copy functions were promoted to JP C at original addresses; see decomp/regions/japan_0_main2.json.
